payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 1 requires the rebuilt tree to apply `raw` 'whatever the host's apply.whitespace says', which is why the spec's notes call for ending T2's line 30 with a trailing space under the fixture's global `apply.whitespace = fix` config. Line 1576 (and every other line the fixture writes, e.g. 1577, 1593-1594) has no trailing whitespace at all, so `apply.whitespace=fix` never has anything to fix and the test cannot tell `git apply --cached --whitespace=nowarn` from a plain `git apply --cached`. Dropping `--whitespace=nowarn` in `_rebuild_tree` leaves every assertion in both witnesses unchanged, so the one requirement the gate results mark `criteria: pass` for is not actually exercised.
